Objective: O1. Design a REM framework for financial AI agents' and task automation agents' security
Achieved: Designed (Chapter 3) and implemented (Section 3.16) for a financial (banking) agent; design values declared for exploration
Not achieved: Supervisor-approved design values; any task-automation setting; the injection classifier

Objective: O2. Evaluate the framework against adversarial attacks
Achieved: Exploratory evaluation on recorded attacks against 21 real agents: offline classification, observe-only decisions, replay sensitivity (Chapter 4)
Not achieved: Enforcing-mode evaluation with live agents; repeated runs; human label audit; adaptive attacks

Objective: O3. Compare performance with existing security approaches
Achieved: Controlled comparison with a same-estimator baseline (B1) and a same-escalation-opportunity variant; recorded outcomes of four distributed defenses for orientation
Not achieved: A controlled comparison with any published defense (NEXUS, AgentTrust, FinHarness or the distributed defenses) on a shared protocol
